videos.script: An API that knows who is asking has answered half the question. {{two}} The other half is what that person may do. Read this order. Refund that one. List every customer. {{questions}} This lesson builds the answer into a small orders API for the bookshop. It has customers, staff and an administrator, and each of them may do different things. {{roles}} Every request passes the same checks, in the same order, in one place. And when the answer is no, the status code says which check said it. {{gates}} You will watch a customer ask for somebody else's order and be told it does not exist. You will watch a token that may only read try to buy a book. {{refusals}} Then you write one test that asks every person every question. And you break the API on purpose, to see the test catch it. {{matrix}}
